name: Before / after
what: Show a change: a slider whose divider sweeps across the before and after pictures (both labelled), or two halves that slam together with a VS badge. With only the after picture, the before is the same picture in grey - a colour grade, a cleanup.
origin: before / after and versus layouts - the template kinds marketplaces list (Mixkit, Envato Elements, Motion Array, Videohive), researched 2026-10-16
motion: slider 100 % -> 50 % (18 f) -> 15 % -> 85 % -> 50 % (S-curves, holds between); versus: halves 14 f (slow end), a 2 f shake, the badge 3 -> 1 in 8 f
